description: Task-specific model-authority probe for the source-backed reduced QNET Furuta model against the independent geometry-derived full-3D analytical model.
scope: simulation model-selection evidence only; not Forest D1 specimen calibration and not physical actuator authority

model_classes.reduced_qnet: source-backed reduced/equivalent nonlinear QNET Furuta dynamics
model_classes.full3d_geometry: geometry-derived articulated 3-D Furuta dynamics with zero pendulum axial inertia

controller_law: 1 kHz sample-and-hold u = clamp(-Kx) using the Control-owned QNET_REFERENCE_TORQUE_GAINS

decision_margin.rationale: A five-percent actuator-range disagreement over 25 control updates is an explicit engineering model-selection margin. It is not a measured hardware tolerance or a claim of physical accuracy.

local_product_sweep.rationale: The sweep deliberately crosses from a very local upright neighborhood toward the current 8 degree balance-entry angle while stressing both signs and bounded pendulum/arm rates. Rate bounds are engineering probes, not measured specimen operating limits.

acceptance.rationale: The gate preserves a useful near-upright reduced-model region while requiring the existing balance-entry boundary to remain visibly outside the same predictive-command margin if the present model classes continue to disagree there. Any future change requires an explicit model-authority review rather than silent threshold drift.
